title: Mayor Gloria Signs Resolution Continuing State-Funded Program for Youth Internships
description: SAN DIEGO – Continuing the success of a program that has helped more than 1,400 young San Diegans launch their public service careers, Mayor Todd Gloria signed a resolution today, March 24, confirming the City of San Diego will extend its Employ & Empower internship program for another year, using state funding, with no cost to the City. This follows the City Council’s vote to approve accepting state grant funds through Youth Service Corps for the fifth year in a row.
